en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a broad cobblestone street lined with 19th‑century buildings and small trees. Horse‑drawn carriages and carts stand along the right side of the street, with pedestrians walking on both sidewalks. A church tower and other civic buildings are visible in the distance. Printed captions appear at the top and bottom of the card in Esperanto and Hungarian, identifying the street and city.
